summary: End-to-end frontend testing of Super Admin 'Paste Application' feature. All 9 scenarios passed: role-gated visibility, dialog open, sample load, parser accuracy on user's exact sample (20/20 fields), validation, save+redirect, detail-page badge/PDF/convert buttons, Quick Entry tile, office_admin gating, and half-baked blob edge case. Created student cleaned up via DELETE.
critical_code_review_comments: PasteApplicationDialog.jsx (~415 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline but still acceptable; sections (paste step, review step, Field/SectionHead) could be split if it grows further.

parseStudentText.js: 'register number' alias ambiguously routes to 10th when key is unqualified. Behaviour is correct per design, but the order-sensitive alias matching (longer match wins) means '+2 Register Number' must be tokenised before the generic 'registernumber' alias — verified working with user sample.
Save flow surfaces each missing field as a separate toast (9 toasts for the half-baked case) — consider aggregating into a single toast with bullet list for less visual noise on large failures.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED one Anupama V V student (id 1fe3325c-7fd9-4e9c-a43e-359c16c77b99) during the happy-path save test. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Paste Application feature is production-ready. Full E2E covered. If extending, also exercise the actual Application PDF download (only the button-visibility was verified — content of the PDF not asserted) and the reference.notes persistence path for community/hostel metadata (the detail page DOES render 'Hostel/Bus: Hostel' note correctly per screenshot).
